name: Ashwagandha Root Whole – 100 gm | Traditional Ayurvedic Herb for Daily Wellness Support
original_description:
Ashwagandha Root Whole – 100 gm | Traditional Ayurvedic Herb for Daily Wellness Support

Rooted in the ancient wisdom of Ayurveda, Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) has been traditionally valued for its deep connection to balance and vitality. The name “Ashwagandha” comes from Sanskrit — ashva meaning “horse,” and gandha meaning “smell” — a reference to the earthy aroma of the root and its traditional association with strength and resilience.

Harvested from the dry regions of India, this whole dried root is carefully selected for its authentic quality and purity. In Ayurvedic practice, Ashwagandha root has long been used as part of daily routines to support natural rhythm, grounding, and overall harmony.

Ideal for those who honor traditional herbal care, this 100 gm pack offers unprocessed, whole Ashwagandha root — perfect for decoctions, powders, or infusion preparations as per your personal wellness ritual.

Why Choose Whole Ashwagandha Root?
- Sourced from trusted regions where the herb thrives naturally
- Unpowdered, unadulterated, and free from fillers or additives
- Ideal for traditional preparation methods — simmer, steep, or grind as needed
- A staple in Ayurvedic households for generations

Whether used in morning tonics, evening infusions, or seasonal rituals, Ashwagandha root holds a revered place in the heritage of mindful living. Store in a cool, dry place to preserve its natural essence.

Note: This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. Use as part of a balanced lifestyle and consult a qualified practitioner if you have specific needs.
